categories.label: 流程编排
categories.description: 选择路线、协调阶段、定制工作流

categories.label: 接入配置
categories.description: 安装就绪、连接与项目配置，不是交付阶段

categories.label: 阶段入口
categories.description: 进入内置生命周期阶段或短流程首阶段

categories.description: PO、DEV、QA 独立会话的准备与交接入口

skills.name: aidlc
skills.scope: 父协调器：路由、派发、状态与审批

skills.name: aidlc-workflow
skills.scope: 团队 DAG、阶段和模板配置；不运行交付

skills.name: aidlc-setup
skills.scope: AIDLC 安装与项目必需项检查

skills.name: aidlc-knowledge-setup
skills.scope: Confluence / TWG 知识接入

skills.name: aidlc-pipeline-setup
skills.scope: GitLab CI/CD 绑定与等待配置

skills.name: aidlc-role-setup
skills.scope: Jira＋GitLab、角色审批与浏览器交接配置

skills.name: aidlc-intake
skills.scope: 需求来源、目标、范围与风险

skills.name: aidlc-spec
skills.scope: 行为规格、FR/NFR 与 AC

skills.name: aidlc-enhance
skills.scope: enhance 路线的 Scope 入口；随后 Implement / Verify

skills.name: aidlc-fix
skills.scope: fix 路线的 Diagnose 入口；随后 Implement / Verify

skills.name: aidlc-architecture
skills.scope: 架构约束、契约与 Architecture Fitness

skills.name: aidlc-quality
skills.scope: 测试策略、Oracle、覆盖与 Quality Fitness；不执行 TDD

skills.name: aidlc-plan
skills.scope: 可验收切片、依赖与实施授权范围

skills.name: aidlc-implement
skills.scope: 软件工程师实现、TDD、自测与候选交接

skills.name: aidlc-verify
skills.scope: 独立 collector 汇总真实双 Gate / AC 证据

skills.name: aidlc-release
skills.scope: 显式团队扩展的发布就绪校验，不自动生产发布

skills.name: aidlc-learn
skills.scope: 显式团队扩展的真实反馈与经验修订

skills.name: aidlc-prd
skills.scope: PO：BRD → PRD；独立分析流

skills.name: aidlc-story
skills.scope: PO：PRD / 原始需求 → 标准 Jira Story＋AC

skills.name: aidlc-test-design
skills.scope: QA：开发前确认共享业务用例；只设计

skills.name: aidlc-qa
skills.scope: QA：冻结候选的浏览器测试与人工观察，不替代最终 Gate

skills.name: aidlc-spec-generation
skills.scope: 细化可验证规格与需求来源映射

skills.name: aidlc-adr
skills.scope: 架构决策草案与取舍，不代行批准

skills.name: aidlc-test-generation
skills.scope: 设计 Oracle/场景；仅批准的 Implement 中可写测试源码

skills.name: aidlc-fitness-check
skills.scope: Implement 自测或 Verify Reviewer 检查；自测不算独立 Gate

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.scope: 仅 Implement：RED → GREEN → REFACTOR

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.scope: 仅 Implement：按独立行为切片实现

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.scope: Implement 失败触发时按需诊断；不增加纠错授权

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.scope: Implement 按需自审；不替代独立 Reviewer

skills.name: aidlc-knowledge-sync
skills.scope: Verify/Learn 批准后的独立知识发布 Hook 或明确重试

skills.name: aidlc-test-sync
skills.scope: 显式同步用例/结果或 DEV 恢复检查；脚本修改交回 Implement
